title: WS-019 - Use webhooks for result export completion
intent: Explain the optional hook parameter available on results preparation endpoints.
short_answer: All prepareResultsXXX actions can include an optional hook URL. When the asynchronous export finishes, EUSurvey calls the hook URL using a GET request. The placeholder TASKID in the hook URL is automatically replaced by the ticket ID, which can then be used to call getResults.
important_conditions: The hook is optional; polling getResults remains supported.
The receiving system should validate and handle the ticket securely.
The hook URL should be reachable by EUSurvey.
related_articles: WS-006 - Use asynchronous tickets and getResults
